lines: Settled 102° at 5:03PM, in 102° to 103°. The noon lean was 100° to 101° at 73% — missed (forecast 101.1, off by 0.9°).
The market agreed at noon (100° to 101° at 68%) and both were wrong.

The high was set at 5:03PM — after the 1:51 PM six-hour group; the hourly reports topped out at 100°, 2° under the settlement — a peak between reports that the 5-minute feed or a corroborated TWC maximum would have seen.
Lesson: the forecast was within a degree and still missed the range — a rounding-line day; the plan’s coin-flip warning is the right read on those.
